Restore the retained pre-import Automerge source before accepting any post-import Desktop mutation if the SQLite item count, source digest, integrity check, or required shell state does not match the imported legacy library.

Set freed.libraryCore.feedBrowseBidirectionalReaderV1.disabled to 1 on the affected device if ordinary all-content ordering, forward or backward paging, scroll anchoring, selection handoff, or memory diverges from the Freed Desktop Automerge compatibility fallback.

Set freed.libraryCore.providerSettingsReaderV1.disabled to 1 on the affected device if provider settings counts, eligibility, ordering, media backup, saved-video synchronization, or memory diverge from the Automerge fallback.

Reject the SQLite candidate before accepting post-import mutations if any ordinary Freed Desktop surface requires the complete item corpus in React or renderer state to preserve its user-visible behavior.
Set freed.libraryCore.savedAnalyticsReaderV1.disabled to 1 on the affected device if the bounded Saved overview diverges, stalls, or increases memory relative to the Automerge fallback.

Set freed.libraryCore.savedFeedReaderV1.disabled to 1 on the affected device if the versioned Saved order, forward traversal, selection handoff, or memory diverges from the Freed Desktop compatibility fallback.
Set freed.libraryCore.searchJumpReaderV1.disabled to 1 on the affected device if SearchJump tags, counts, selected-item actions, cancellation, or memory diverge from the Automerge fallback.

Restore the retained pre-cutover Automerge library with the last released Freed Desktop build if native SQLite integrity, item counts, bounded reads, mutations, backup, or immutable replication cannot preserve the verified cutover frontier without the retired Automerge runtime.

Set freed.libraryCore.immutableGoogleDriveV1.enabled and freed.libraryCore.pwaIndexedDbV1.enabled to 0 on the affected devices if immutable checkpoint convergence, epoch-scoped intent publication, result reconciliation, or bounded memory diverges from the retained local SQLite state.

Restore the previous PWA deployment if the IndexedDB Library Core cannot import the active immutable checkpoint, preserve bounded reads, publish signed intents, reconcile results, or complete factory reset without the retired Automerge runtime.

releaseBody:
(AI Generated).

## Freed v26.8.1400

Adds renderer memory attribution against a pre-hydration shell baseline, capture, login, and scraping platform work, and reader, sidebar, and settings UX work

### Features

- Adds renderer memory attribution against a pre-hydration shell baseline
- Defines item locality and deletion semantics with a lossless flat feed projection
- Moves cloud merges off the main thread and replaces JSON number arrays with compact IPC bodies

### Fixes

- Sync and update reliability fixes
- Reader, feed, and header polish
- Release build and type-safety cleanup
- Repair SQLite browser regression boundary

### Follow-ups

- Sync, cloud, and pairing infrastructure
- Release workflow and build-system work
- Pin the destructive merge guard policy and its blind spots

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
